verdict.rationale: Vue's official docs list a "Migration from Vue 2" guide, a first-party upgrade path for existing projects. The evidence is only a navigation title, so the guide's depth and coverage are unproven. missing for 10: any detail on the guide's content (breaking-change lists, step-by-step instructions, migration build/compat tooling), evidence of upgrade guidance for minor/other version jumps, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the guide works in practice.
